claims: T is the 20th letter of the Latin alphabet.
T cells are immune system lymphocytes.
T is a common abbreviation for temperature.
T is a common abbreviation for time.
T represents a voiceless alveolar plosive consonant.
T represents a glottal stop in many English dialects, particularly Cockney.
T is the stock ticker symbol for AT&T on the NYSE.
The letter T is often pronounced "tee" (/ˈtiː/).
A T-cell is a type of white blood cell.
T-cells are essential for the immune system.
"The T" is shortened from "spill the tea."
"spill the tea" means "the truth" or gossip.
T-glottalization involves replacing the 't' sound with a glottal stop.
In French, t is added in verb-subject inversions for pronunciation (e.g., aim-t-il).
